layouts.job: Open the deck and establish its promise.
layouts.contentShape: One title, one short framing line, and minimal metadata.

layouts.job: Let one real image, screenshot, or document carry the claim.
layouts.contentShape: One dominant media field with concise annotation.

layouts.job: Reveal a product, interface, or object as the primary subject.
layouts.contentShape: One inspectable product view with one value statement.

layouts.job: Reset pacing and announce a new argument phase.
layouts.contentShape: Section number or label, thesis, and optional one-line setup.

layouts.job: Relate two different but connected content fields.
layouts.contentShape: Two asymmetric columns such as claim/evidence or concept/example.

layouts.job: Make one to four verified numbers legible and consequential.
layouts.contentShape: Dominant metric, unit, comparison, and implication.
avoid: more than four equal focal numbers

layouts.job: Show a real A/B, before/after, option, or scenario contrast.
layouts.contentShape: Exactly two primary sides with aligned dimensions.

layouts.job: Explain change over time or a linear sequence.
layouts.contentShape: A dated axis or ordered sequence with concise milestones.

layouts.job: Explain a mechanism, system, hierarchy, or feedback structure.
layouts.contentShape: Nodes and labeled relationships with one reading direction.

layouts.job: Prove a quantitative claim through a faithful visualization.
layouts.contentShape: One primary chart with direct labels and a takeaway.

layouts.job: Explain geography, basin, route, market, or regional concentration.
layouts.contentShape: One map with bounded callouts and a geographic takeaway.

layouts.job: Present three to six parallel capabilities or ideas.
layouts.contentShape: A small set of equal or deliberately weighted modules.

layouts.job: Build an evidence set from multiple related images or examples.
layouts.contentShape: Two to six media items with captions or one highlighted item.

layouts.job: Land one consequential sentence or reset attention.
layouts.contentShape: One sentence, phrase, or number with minimal support.

layouts.job: Use a sourced voice or primary text as evidence or transition.
layouts.contentShape: One quotation, source, and optional interpretation.

layouts.job: Support exact comparison or lookup while preserving a clear conclusion.
layouts.contentShape: One bounded table plus a visible takeaway or decision field.

layouts.job: Resolve the opening promise into a judgment or action.
layouts.contentShape: One conclusion, decision, or next move.

layouts.job: Walk through an interface, workflow, or code path in a controlled sequence.
layouts.contentShape: One primary demo surface with numbered steps or progressive states.

layouts.job: Organize several claims, sources, risks, or proof objects into one reviewable field.
layouts.contentShape: A structured ledger or evidence matrix with one synthesis panel.

layouts.job: Solve a content shape that the registered layouts cannot express faithfully.
layouts.contentShape: A documented content-specific composition.
requires: reason the registered library is insufficient
